name: Mia'Chill
desc: A calm storyteller who leaves room for exploration, recovery and small discoveries.
ooc_desc: A slower storyteller. Positive and neutral incidents are more common, while difficult events are less frequent.
welcome_speech: May your colony find a little peace.
round_speech: There is still time to recover.

name: Cas'Classic
desc: A balanced storyteller who builds a steady mixture of setbacks and relief.
ooc_desc: A classic pace with positive, neutral and negative incidents selected from each cell's local pool.
round_speech: Every setback leaves room for a response.

name: Randall's Gambit
desc: An unpredictable storyteller who likes sudden turns and unusual incidents.
ooc_desc: Event categories are chosen with high variability. Major incidents are possible, but never tied to a faction system.
welcome_speech: Let chance decide what happens next.
round_speech: No plan survives its encounter with chance.

name: Edd Catastrophe
desc: A harsh storyteller who favours difficult and major incidents.
ooc_desc: A relentless pace with more severe local incidents and shorter breaks between them.
welcome_speech: The quiet will not last forever.

name: Mia & Edd'Challenge
desc: A mixed storyteller whose incidents alternate between relief and serious pressure.
ooc_desc: A challenging, mixed pace that can produce major incidents without using faction-driven events.
welcome_speech: A difficult story can still hold moments of peace.
round_speech: The next turn may bring relief or pressure.
